name: Post-Matric Scholarship BC EBC
provider: Backward & Extremely Backward Classes Welfare Dept, Govt. of Bihar
eligibilityCriteria: BC & EBC students residing in Bihar. Family income below ₹3,00,000 per annum. Enrolled in recognized senior secondary or vocational school.
amountOrBenefit: Full tuition fee reimbursement + ₹4,000/year maintenance allowance

name: Post-Matric Scholarship SC ST
provider: SC & ST Welfare Department, Government of Bihar
eligibilityCriteria: Scheduled Caste & Scheduled Tribe students of Bihar. Family annual income not exceeding ₹2,50,000.
amountOrBenefit: 100% course fee waiver + ₹5,000 annual study stipend & book allowance

name: Mukhyamantri Balak Balika Protsahan Yojana
eligibilityCriteria: Students who passed Matriculation examination in 1st division from Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB).
amountOrBenefit: One-time financial incentive of ₹10,000 directly via DBT

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
provider: Welfare of SC and BC Department, Haryana
eligibilityCriteria: Day scholars and hostellers belonging to Scheduled Castes in Haryana studying in government or recognized schools.
amountOrBenefit: ₹3,500 per annum for day scholars and ₹7,000 per annum for hostellers

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for BC Students
eligibilityCriteria: Backward Class (Block A & B) students with family Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) verified income under ₹2.5 Lakhs.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
eligibilityCriteria: Haryana domicile SC students enrolled in intermediate or diploma courses with min. 75% attendance.
amountOrBenefit: Up to ₹12,000 per year maintenance grant + exam fee coverage

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
provider: Scheduled Tribe, SC, Minority and BC Welfare Dept, Jharkhand
eligibilityCriteria: Permanent resident of Jharkhand belonging to Scheduled Caste category studying in Class 1 through 10.
amountOrBenefit: ₹1,500 to ₹4,500 per year graded by class level

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
eligibilityCriteria: Scheduled Tribe boys and girls enrolled in primary or secondary classes. Annual family income <= ₹2.5 Lakhs.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for BC OBC Students
eligibilityCriteria: Backward Caste (BC-I & BC-II) students of Jharkhand having valid caste and income certificates.
